about: Country cards for lives born in Mexico. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Mexico (MX) ===================== Tandas: 20% of Mexican savers use tandas (INEGI ENIF 2024, via El Universal and Milenio). Risk ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your coworkers organise a tanda: everyone pays in every fortnight, and each time one person takes the whole pot. A fifth of Mexicans who save use tandas.

zh..x: 同事办了一个互助会（tanda）：每两周大家交一次钱，每次由一人拿走全部会钱。墨西哥有储蓄的人当中，有五分之一参加互助会。

zht..x: 同事辦了一個互助會（tanda）：每兩週大家交一次錢，每次由一人拿走全部會錢。墨西哥有儲蓄的人當中，有五分之一參加互助會。

events.src: AFORE: the 2020 reform raises employer contributions from 5.15% to about 13.9% of pay by 2030, 15% in total (Deloitte; Principal; IADB). Voluntary contributions can be deductible: the tax saving (about 10%) is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: The 2020 pension reform raises employer contributions to your AFORE from 5.15% to about 13.9% of pay by 2030. You can add voluntary contributions, which can be tax-deductible.

zh..x: 2020年的养老金改革让雇主存进你退休基金（AFORE）的比例，从工资的5.15%逐步提高到2030年的约13.9%。你可以自愿多存，还可能抵税。

zht..x: 2020年的退休金改革讓僱主存進你退休基金（AFORE）的比例，從薪水的5.15%逐步提高到2030年的約13.9%。你可以自願多存，還可能抵稅。

events.src: Infonavit: employers pay 5% of pay into the worker's housing subaccount, usable as the down payment with an Infonavit loan (Ley del INFONAVIT art. 29; El Imparcial, 2025). Loan rates by income (about 3% real) are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: cash += sub; const t = T('mx_sub', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.mx_sub'), v: sub, note: M('note.got', { a: MN(sub) }) }); buyAt(P, { dp: .1, fee: .03, r: .03, n: 30, lk: 'trk.mx_infonavit', fixed: true, flex: true })

en..x: Your employer pays 5% of your wage into an Infonavit housing account. With it and an Infonavit loan you can buy a home ({p}); your account holds about {a}.
en..buy.s: About {d} more up front, then {m} a year.

zh..x: 雇主每月把你工资的5%存进住房基金（Infonavit）账户。用这笔钱加上住房基金贷款，你可以买一间房子（{p}）；你的账户里约有{a}。
zh..buy.s: 再付约{d}的首付，之后每年{m}。

zht..x: 僱主每月把你薪水的5%存進住房基金（Infonavit）帳戶。用這筆錢加上住房基金貸款，你可以買一間房子（{p}）；你的帳戶里約有{a}。
zht..buy.s: 再付約{d}的頭期款，之後每年{m}。

events.src: Aguinaldo: at least 15 days' wages, paid before 20 December (Ley Federal del Trabajo, art. 87; PROFEDET).

en..x: By law your aguinaldo, at least 15 days’ wages, must be paid before 20 December.

zh..x: 依法你的年终奖金（aguinaldo）至少是15天的工资，必须在12月20日前发放。

zht..x: 依法你的年終獎金（aguinaldo）至少是15天的薪水，必須在12月20日前發放。

events.src: Seasonal work in the US: 315,328 H-2A visas were issued in 2024, over 90% to Mexicans (USAFacts; Wilson Center for FY2019); Mexico received a record $64.7bn in remittances in 2024 (Banxico, via LatinNews). Employers pay travel and housing under H-2A. Pay and season length are ESTIMATES.

en..x: A US farm offers you seasonal work on an H-2A visa at about {a} a year; the employer pays travel and housing. Mexicans receive over 90% of these visas, and Mexico received a record $64.7 billion in remittances in 2024.

zh..x: 一家美国农场请你持H-2A签证去做季节工，年薪约{a}；雇主负担路费和住宿。这类签证九成以上发给墨西哥人，2024年墨西哥的侨汇创下647亿美元的纪录。

zht..x: 一家美國農場請你持H-2A簽證去做季節工，年薪約{a}；僱主負擔路費和住宿。這類簽證九成以上發給墨西哥人，2024年墨西哥的僑匯創下647億美元的紀錄。

events.src: Hurricanes: Otis struck Acapulco as a category 5 storm in October 2023 (SMN/CONAGUA). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: In October 2023 Hurricane Otis hit Acapulco as a category 5 storm. Your town lies on the coast.

zh..x: 2023年10月，飓风“奥蒂斯”以五级强度袭击阿卡普尔科。你住的小镇在海边。

zht..x: 2023年10月，颶風「奧蒂斯」以五級強度襲擊阿卡普爾科。你住的小鎮在海邊。

events.src: IMSS for independent workers: voluntary enrolment for MX$18,870 a year from Feb 2025 (MX$20,538 from Feb 2026) (El Imparcial; UnoTV): ≈ 0.19 of the game's typical wage (MX$99,000). Share of bills covered is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Independent workers can join IMSS voluntarily for a yearly fee: MX$18,870 from February 2025.
en..join.h: It pays about 75% of your medical bills.

zh..x: 自由职业者可以自愿缴年费加入社会保险局（IMSS）：2025年2月起每年MX$18,870。

zht..t: 自由職業者的社會保險
zht..x: 自由職業者可以自願繳年費加入社會保險局（IMSS）：2025年2月起每年MX$18,870。

events.src: Cetes: 28-day Cetes paid 9.87% in January and 7.48% by late July 2025 (Banco Base; Monex); with inflation near 4%, about 3.5% real: an ESTIMATE. Cetesdirecto sells from 100 pesos.

en..x: With Cetesdirecto you can buy government bills from 100 pesos. 28-day Cetes paid 9.9% in January and 7.5% by July 2025, while inflation was about 4%. You have {a} to put somewhere.
en..cetes.s: Move {a} in. About 3.5% a year after inflation.

zh..x: 通过Cetesdirecto，100比索就能买国库券。2025年28天期国库券的利率1月是9.9%，7月降到7.5%，通胀约4%。你有{a}要找地方放。
zh..cetes.s: 放入{a}。扣除通胀后每年约3.5%。

zht..x: 透過Cetesdirecto，100比索就能買國庫券。2025年28天期國庫券的利率1月是9.9%，7月降到7.5%，通膨約4%。你有{a}要找地方放。
zht..cetes.s: 放入{a}。扣除通膨後每年約3.5%。

events.src: Quinceañeras: a girl’s fifteenth birthday is often celebrated with a Mass, a hall, a dinner, a dress and a waltz, with padrinos (sponsors) from the family paying for parts of it. Costs (a large party about MX$150,000 ≈ 1.5 before the padrinos’ share) are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Mexico, about MX$99,200 a year (10,000 PPP dollars × 9.92).

en..x: {n} turns fifteen this year. Her cousins had big quinceañeras with a hall, a band and a waltz; the godparents have offered to pay for the cake and the dress.
en..big: A big party with a hall and a band
en..big.s: About {a} after what the padrinos pay.
en..mid: A party at home with the family
en..trip: A trip, which she says she prefers
en..trip.s: About {a} for the two of you.

zh..x: {n}今年满十五岁。她的表姐妹们都办了盛大的成年礼，有宴会厅、乐队和华尔兹；教父母说可以出蛋糕和礼服的钱。
zh..big: 办宴会厅加乐队的大派对
zh..big.s: 扣掉教父母出的钱，大约{a}。
zh..trip: 去旅行，她说她比较想要这个

zht..x: {n}今年滿十五歲。她的表姊妹們都辦了盛大的成年禮，有宴會廳、樂團和華爾滋；教父母說可以出蛋糕和禮服的錢。
zht..big: 辦宴會廳加樂團的大派對
zht..big.s: 扣掉教父母出的錢，大約{a}。
zht..trip: 去旅行，她說她比較想要這個

events.src: Ejido land: about 51% of Mexico’s land is social property held by 32,121 ejidos and communities (National Agrarian Registry, 2017, via UNAM). Since the 1992 reform an ejido’s assembly can let a plot become private property (dominio pleno), and about 285,000 plots have done so (RAN, via UNAM); plots sold without it can be contested by the ejido or the seller’s family. Prices, gains and the odds of a dispute are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Mexico, about MX$99,200 a year (10,000 PPP dollars × 9.92).

en..t: A cheap plot on ejido land
en..x: On the edge of town, an ejidatario is selling plots on ejido land for a third of the price of plots with a private title. Several neighbours have already started building there.
en..ejido.h: Cheap land that should gain in value, but without full title the sale can be contested.
en..lote: A plot with a private title
en.trk.mx_lote: A plot with a private title

zh..x: 城郊有一位公社社员在卖公社土地（ejido）上的地块，价格只有私有产权地块的三分之一。好几户邻居已经在那里盖房子了。
zh..ejido.h: 便宜、应该会增值，但没有完整产权，买卖可能被告无效。
zh..lote.s: 大约{a}，在公证人面前签约。

zht..x: 城郊有一位公社社員在賣公社土地（ejido）上的地塊，價格只有私有產權地塊的三分之一。好幾戶鄰居已經在那裡蓋房子了。
zht..ejido.h: 便宜、應該會增值，但沒有完整產權，買賣可能被告無效。
zht..lote.s: 大約{a}，在公證人面前簽約。

events.src: Disputes over ejido plots go to the agrarian courts; the seller’s family and other ejidatarios have a right of first refusal when parcel rights are sold (Ley Agraria, articles 80 and 84). Amounts and odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: pay(.1 * base); if (roll('mx_ejido2') < .5) { lots.mx_ejido.v = .2 * v; happy -= 4 } else happy -= 1

en..t: The seller’s family wants the land back
en..x: The ejidatario who sold you the plot has died, and his children say he had no right to sell it without them. Your plot, worth about {a}, is now in dispute at the agrarian court.
en..pay: Pay his children to sign it over
en..lawyer.h: Half the time you lose most of the plot’s value.

zh..t: 卖家的家人要讨回土地
zh..x: 卖地给你的那位公社社员过世了，他的子女说他没经过他们同意，无权卖地。你那块大约值{a}的地，现在闹上了农地法院。
zh..lawyer.h: 有一半的机会会失去这块地大部分的价值。

zht..t: 賣家的家人要討回土地
zht..x: 賣地給你的那位公社社員過世了，他的子女說他沒經過他們同意，無權賣地。你那塊大約值{a}的地，現在鬧上了農地法院。
zht..lawyer.h: 有一半的機會會失去這塊地大部分的價值。

events.src: Rents in Mexico City: since 2024 the Civil Code caps yearly rent rises for homes at the previous year’s inflation (article 2448 D), upheld by the Supreme Court in February 2026; inflation was 3.69% in 2025 (INEGI, via El Financiero). Protests against gentrification and short-term lets spread through Roma and Condesa in July 2025. The landlord’s response, rents and commuting costs are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Mexico, about MX$99,200 a year (10,000 PPP dollars × 9.92).

opts.do: if (roll('mx_renta') < .4) { spend('mx_mv', .05 * base, 'trk.mx_mv'); T('mx_rup', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.mx_rup') }); rec('mx_rup', .04 * base, 5); happy -= 1 }
T('mx_rup', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.mx_rup') }); rec('mx_rup', .08 * base, 5)
spend('mx_mv', .05 * base, 'trk.mx_mv'); T('mx_far', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.mx_far') }); rec('mx_far', -.06 * base, 6, -.4); happy -= 2

en..x: Your landlord in the city centre wants 30% more when the contract renews: flats nearby now rent to foreigners working remotely. The law caps rises at last year’s inflation, but he says he can always find someone else.
en..cap.s: The law is on your side; the landlord may not renew.
en..cap.h: Often it works, but some landlords refuse to renew and you have to move.
en..edomex: Move out to the State of Mexico
en..edomex.s: About {a} to move; a much cheaper rent and a long commute.
en..edomex.h: Rent saved, but Health a little lower each year and Happiness −2.
en.trk.mx_far: Rent saved living outside the city

zh..x: 市中心的房东说续约时房租要涨30%：附近的公寓现在都租给远程工作的外国人。法律规定涨幅不能超过去年的通胀，可他说随时都找得到别人租。
zh..cap.s: 法律站在你这边；但房东可能不续约。
zh..cap.h: 常常有用，但有些房东会拒绝续约，你只好搬家。
zh..edomex.s: 搬家大约{a}；房租便宜很多，但通勤很远。
zh..edomex.h: 省下房租，但健康每年少一点，幸福感 −2。

zht..x: 市中心的房東說續約時房租要漲30%：附近的公寓現在都租給遠端工作的外國人。法律規定漲幅不能超過去年的通膨，可是他說隨時都找得到別人租。
zht..cap.s: 法律站在你這邊；但房東可能不續約。
zht..cap.h: 常常有用，但有些房東會拒絕續約，你只好搬家。
zht..edomex.s: 搬家大約{a}；房租便宜很多，但通勤很遠。
zht..edomex.h: 省下房租，但健康每年少一點，幸福感 −2。

events.src: Delivery work: since 1 July 2025, people working through apps such as DiDi, Uber and Rappi who earn at least a monthly minimum wage are covered by IMSS social security, paid by the platforms (IMSS pilot, DOF, June 2025). Motorbikes are widely sold on weekly instalments. Earnings, the bike’s cost and the odds of an accident are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Mexico, about MX$99,200 a year (10,000 PPP dollars × 9.92).

opts.do: T('mx_mpay', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.mx_mpay') }); rec('mx_mpay', .12 * base, 2); T('mx_del', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.mx_del') }); rec('mx_del', -.25 * base, 4, -.4); happy -= 1

en..x: A friend makes good money delivering for the apps in the evenings and at weekends. The store will sell you a motorbike today for small weekly payments, and the apps now register riders with IMSS.
en..ride: Buy the bike and deliver after work
en..ride.s: Weekly payments of about {a} a year for two years.
en..ride.h: Extra income of about a quarter of a typical wage a year; Health a little lower each year; Happiness −1; accidents happen.

zh..x: 一个朋友晚上和周末替外卖平台送餐，赚得不错。商店今天就能卖你一辆摩托车，每周付一点；而且平台现在会替骑手办社会保险（IMSS）。
zh..ride: 买摩托车，下班后送外卖
zh..ride.s: 分期每周付，两年内每年大约{a}。
zh..ride.h: 每年多赚大约四分之一个一般工资；健康每年少一点；幸福感 −1；可能会出车祸。

zht..x: 一個朋友晚上和週末替外送平台送餐，賺得不錯。商店今天就能賣你一輛機車，每週付一點；而且平台現在會替外送員辦社會保險（IMSS）。
zht..ride.s: 分期每週付，兩年內每年大約{a}。
zht..ride.h: 每年多賺大約四分之一個一般薪資；健康每年少一點；幸福感 −1；可能會出車禍。

events.src: Motorcyclists are among the road users most often hurt in Mexico (INEGI road accident statistics); IMSS covers work accidents of registered platform workers since 2025. Effects are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A car turned across you on a wet evening. Your leg is badly bruised and the bike needs repairs; IMSS covers the clinic.
en..rest.h: Health −6, Happiness −2; the delivery income ends.
en..back: Get back on as soon as you can

zh..x: 一个下雨的晚上，一辆车突然转弯切到你前面。你的腿严重瘀伤，摩托车也得修；看诊费由社会保险出。
zh..rest.h: 健康 −6，幸福感 −2；送餐收入没了。

zht..x: 一個下雨的晚上，一輛車突然轉彎切到你前面。你的腿嚴重瘀傷，機車也得修；看診費由社會保險出。
zht..rest.h: 健康 −6，幸福感 −2；外送收入沒了。

events.src: ‘Chocolate’ cars: used cars brought in from the United States without import papers; a decree from January 2022, extended several times, let owners register them for a one-off MX$2,500 fee, and more than 2.5 million had been registered by October 2024 (REPUVE, via El Imparcial). Prices (about MX$60,000 ≈ 0.6 for a regularised US pickup against MX$110,000 ≈ 1.1 for a similar Mexican car) and repairs are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Mexico, about MX$99,200 a year (10,000 PPP dollars × 9.92).

opts.do: spend('mx_choc', .6 * base, 'trk.mx_choc'); car = { type: 'used', bal: 0, pay: 0, trk: 'mx_choc' }; happy += 2; if (roll('mx_choc') < .3) spend('mx_chocfix', .1 * base, 'trk.mx_chocfix')
spend('mx_nac', 1.1 * base, 'trk.mx_nac'); car = { type: 'used', bal: 0, pay: 0, trk: 'mx_nac' }; happy += 2

en..x: A neighbour is selling a pickup brought in from Texas, newly registered under the government’s scheme for ‘chocolate’ cars. It costs about half of what a Mexican car of the same age would.
en..choc.h: Happiness +2; parts can be hard to find, and some of these cars hide old damage.
en..nac: A Mexican used car from a dealer

zh..x: 邻居要卖一辆从得州开过来的皮卡，刚依照政府的“巧克力车”合法化方案登记好。价格大约只有同车龄墨西哥车的一半。
zh..choc: 买这辆合法化的美国皮卡
zh..choc.h: 幸福感 +2；零件可能不好找，有些车还藏着旧伤。
zh..nac: 向车行买墨西哥二手车

zht..x: 鄰居要賣一輛從德州開過來的皮卡，剛依照政府的「巧克力車」合法化方案登記好。價格大約只有同車齡墨西哥車的一半。
zht..choc: 買這輛合法化的美國皮卡
zht..choc.h: 幸福感 +2；零件可能不好找，有些車還藏著舊傷。
zht..nac: 向車行買墨西哥二手車

events.src: El Buen Fin: a yearly November sales weekend since 2011, when shops offer months without interest (meses sin intereses) on credit cards (Profeco; Secretaría de Economía). Missing a payment ends the interest-free deal, and card interest for people who don’t pay in full averages over 30% a year (Banxico). The TV prices and the odds of falling behind are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Mexico, about MX$99,200 a year (10,000 PPP dollars × 9.92).

en..x: It’s the Buen Fin weekend, and the 65-inch TV you wanted is on offer at 18 months without interest on your credit card.
en..msi: Buy it at 18 months without interest
en..msi.h: Happiness +2; free credit as long as you never miss a payment.
en..cash: A smaller TV, paid in cash
en.trk.mx_bf: A TV at months without interest

zh..x: “好周末”促销到了，你想要的65英寸电视用信用卡可以分18期零利率。
zh..msi.h: 幸福感 +2；只要一期都不漏缴，就不用付利息。
zh..cash: 付现金买小一点的电视

zht..x: 「好週末」促銷到了，你想要的65吋電視用信用卡可以分18期零利率。
zht..msi.h: 幸福感 +2；只要一期都不漏繳，就不用付利息。
zht..cash: 付現金買小一點的電視

events.src: Missing a ‘months without interest’ payment usually moves the rest of the balance onto the card’s normal interest (Condusef). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A car repair left you short and you missed a payment on the TV. The bank has moved the rest of it onto your card’s normal interest rate.
en..min.h: The interest keeps adding up; Happiness −2.

zh..x: 修车让你手头紧，电视的分期款漏缴了一期。银行把剩下的金额改按信用卡的一般利率计息。
zh..min.h: 利息会一直累积；幸福感 −2。

zht..x: 修車讓你手頭緊，電視的分期款漏繳了一期。銀行把剩下的金額改按信用卡的一般利率計息。
zht..min.h: 利息會一直累積；幸福感 −2。

events.src: The northern border: from January 2026 the minimum wage is MX$440.87 a day in the northern border zone against MX$315.04 in the rest of the country (CONASAMI, Dec 2025), and factories there are hiring as firms move production closer to the US. Pay, living costs and home prices after the move are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Mexico, about MX$99,200 a year (10,000 PPP dollars × 9.92).

en..t: A factory job in the north
en..x: Factories in Ciudad Juárez and Monterrey are hiring. The minimum wage in the border zone is 40% higher than at home, and a cousin there has a spare room.
en..go.s: Higher pay, far from family; prices are higher too.
en..go.h: Pay about 30% higher, living costs about 10% higher, homes about 20% dearer; Relationships −4.

zh..x: 华雷斯城和蒙特雷的工厂在招人。边境地区的最低工资比家乡高40%，那里的表哥还有一间空房。
zh..go.s: 薪水较高，离家远；物价也比较高。

events.src: Titulación: in Mexico finishing your courses isn’t enough to practise many professions; you need the título and the professional licence (cédula profesional, Dirección General de Profesiones), usually after a thesis, an exam or a paid diploma course, and many graduates put it off for years. Costs (about MX$25,000 ≈ 0.25) and the pay effect are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Mexico, about MX$99,200 a year (10,000 PPP dollars × 9.92).

en..x: You finished all your courses years ago but never did the thesis, so you have no título or cédula. Some job offers ask for them. Your university runs a paid diploma course that counts instead.
en..tit.s: About {a} and six months of Saturdays.
en..skip.s: Your work experience speaks for you.
en..skip.h: Some jobs stay out of reach.
en.trk.mx_tit: The diploma course for your título
en.trk.mx_titb: A degree with título and cédula

events.src: AFORE withdrawal for unemployment: after 46 days without work you can take out part of your retirement savings, about 30 days of salary (or, for older accounts, up to 90 days or 11.5% of the balance), once every five years; the weeks of contributions it represents are deducted, which can lower or delay your pension unless you pay it back (CONSAR, via El Imparcial and Expansión). The amount and the pension effect are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Six weeks after the layoff, the AFORE app says you can withdraw part of your retirement savings for unemployment.
en..take.h: Happiness +1; the weeks it represents come off your record, so your pension is a little smaller.

zh..t: 被裁员后的退休金账户
zh..x: 被裁员六个星期后，退休金账户（AFORE）的App通知你，可以申请失业提领一部分退休储蓄。
zh..take.h: 幸福感 +1；对应的缴费周数会被扣掉，退休金会少一点。

zht..t: 被裁員後的退休金帳戶
zht..x: 被裁員六個星期後，退休金帳戶（AFORE）的App通知你，可以申請失業提領一部分退休儲蓄。
zht..take.h: 幸福感 +1；對應的繳費週數會被扣掉，退休金會少一點。

events.src: UNAM: tuition at the National Autonomous University is famously symbolic, a few centavos a year, but places are scarce and filled by an entrance exam taken by well over a hundred thousand applicants a year, and many try again the following year (UNAM admissions). Private fees, the share refunded and the odds of a place on a second try are an ESTIMATE.

later.mx_unam: if (roll('mx_unam') < .45) { const c = trk.sk_edu ? trk.sk_edu.cost : 0, x = .85 * c, y = Math.min(sloan, x); sloan -= y; cash += x - y; log(M('log.mx_unamOk'), 'good') } else log(M('log.mx_unamNo'), '')

en..x: You missed the UNAM entrance exam cut-off by a few points. UNAM’s fees are almost nothing; the private university that accepted you charges every month.
en..again: Take a year and try again
en..again.s: Study for the next exam; the private place won’t wait.
en..again.h: Happiness −2 and a year’s delay; a bit under half get in on the second try, and then the fees are refunded.
en.log.mx_unamOk: You got into UNAM on your second try.
en.log.mx_unamNo: You missed UNAM again and stayed at the private university.

zh..x: 你差几分没考上墨西哥国立自治大学（UNAM）。UNAM几乎不收学费；录取你的私立大学则每个月都要缴学费。
zh..again.s: 准备下一次考试；私立大学的名额不会等你。
zh..again.h: 幸福感 −2，晚一年；第二次考上的不到一半，考上的话学费会退还。
zh.log.mx_unamOk: 你第二次考上了国立自治大学。
zh.log.mx_unamNo: 你又没考上国立自治大学，继续读私立大学。

zht..again.h: 幸福感 −2，晚一年；第二次考上的不到一半，考上的話學費會退還。
zht.log.mx_unamOk: 你第二次考上了國立自治大學。
zht.log.mx_unamNo: 你又沒考上國立自治大學，繼續讀私立大學。
